items.claim: An endpoint surfaced by web page source review is a triage lead whose severity depends on what that endpoint exposes, ranging from an authentication bypass to a sensitive information leak.
items.body:
An endpoint surfaced by web page source review is a triage lead whose severity depends on what that endpoint exposes, ranging from an authentication bypass to a sensitive information leak.

HackTricks reference: codereviewtips (https://kathan19.gitbook.io/howtohunt/web-page-source-code-review/codereviewtips.md)
items.disproof: The endpoint turns out to be unreachable or fully authorized and exposes neither sensitive data nor an authentication decision.

sources.quote: But if they work and they are discovered by an attacker, it can lead to vulnerabilities such as authentication bypass and sensitive information leak, depending on the exposed endpoint.
This information may include details regarding the configuration or capabilities of the target, clues as to the timing or nature of activities, or otherwise sensitive information.
